name: Pulsar 250
summary: Italian-made fully automatic clinical chemistry analyzer from Edif's PRO series, running up to 250 tests per hour. Refrigerated 36-bottle reagent rotor, 36 + 36 sample positions, barcode readers for samples and reagents as standard, 80 washable cuvettes and an optional ISE module.

specs.label: Test types
specs.value: End point, bichromatic end point, differential end point, differential end point sample blank, fixed time, kinetic, kinetic bichromatic

specs.label: Precision
specs.value: Typical 2.0% CV for end point and kinetic

specs.label: Sample tray
specs.value: 36 + 36 positions: 12 – 13 mm barcoded tubes (5 – 7 mL) or 2 mL cups, free standard/control/urgent positions

specs.label: Reagent tray
specs.value: Removable rotor with 36 bottles of 50 or 20 mL (optional 38 or 15 mL), up to 1,440 mL total

specs.label: Refrigeration
specs.value: Reagents and samples cooled about 15 °C below room temperature

specs.label: Barcode
specs.value: Sample and reagent barcode readers as standard

specs.label: Pipetting precision
specs.value: 2% CV at 1 µL, 1.5% CV at 2 µL, 1% CV at 4 µL

specs.label: Sampling arm
specs.value: 1 needle, capacitive liquid level detection, 3-axis shock sensor

specs.label: Dilution
specs.value: In-needle dilution and automatic pre-dilution in a cuvette up to 1:100

specs.label: Cuvette rotor
specs.value: 80 washable direct-reading cuvettes, up to 30,000 tests per rotor

specs.label: Light source
specs.value: Halogen lamp, 6 V / 10 W, extended UV emission

specs.label: Bandwidth
specs.value: ± 2 nm on peak, band pass ± 10 nm

specs.label: Calibration
specs.value: 1 to 8 standards per test; linear (factor, linear, regression) and non-linear (cubic spline, polylinear, multi-parameter, logit-log 4P and 5P)

specs.label: Quality control
specs.value: 3 levels per test, one-month monitoring, reagent/calibrator/control lot tracking

specs.label: LIS
specs.value: Ethernet LAN, standard ASTM ASCII protocol

specs.label: Power supply
specs.value: 100 – 240 V AC, 50/60 Hz; under 200 VA (PC excluded)

features: Sample and reagent barcode readers as standard
Capacitive liquid level detection and 3-axis needle shock sensor
Linear and non-linear calibration with up to 8 standards
